source='''def transform(grid):
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    if not coords:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in coords)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in coords)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in coords]
    height = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    width = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[x][y] == 0 for x, y in cells):
                for x, y in cells:
                    out[x][y] = 8
    return out
'''
